name: System, large (Kubernetes, GitOps, Terraform)
summary: The large tier of the system bundles: the same Spring Modulith API and React web app as the medium tier, deployed to Kubernetes. One Helm chart (web, api, worker; restricted pod security, NetworkPolicy matrix, HPA, PDB, ExternalSecrets, Traefik ingress, values schema, 49 helm-unittest tests), kustomize platform overlays for dev/staging/prod (CloudNativePG with PgBouncer and backups, quota, default-deny), Argo CD and Flux definitions, Terraform modules for network, cluster, database and secrets, and OpenTelemetry, Prometheus SLO burn-rate rules and Grafana dashboards. Every manifest is linted, schema-checked and policy-scanned in pinned containers; nothing here has been applied to a real cluster.
features: One chart, three workloads: web, api, worker (the API image with the jobs on); digest-only images in production
GitOps for Argo CD and Flux; kustomize overlays for the platform layer; Terraform modules with locked providers
SLO burn-rate alerts with promtool tests, OTLP collector, Grafana dashboards

toolchain.installHint: The checks run in pinned containers: install Docker (https://docs.docker.com/get-docker/). Node is only needed by AICO itself.
